campaign: Exact magic-number inventory, RepoDB closure authority, and systematic elimination
doctrine: Follow skill.md. RepoDB owns closure evidence; the source census owns the complete deterministic file queue. Audit every non-generated Go file, one row at a time, in scanner order within each ownership wave. A file closes only after every numeric literal, named constant, assumption hint, repeated policy site, and test policy copy is classified by syntax and ownership. First delete, derive, reuse, or move the value to its existing typed authority. Model, tokenizer, tensor, topology, and training facts come from artifact metadata, profiles, recipes, or compiled plans. Protocol, ABI, mathematical, and irreducible fixture values may remain only with exact typed dispositions. Constants may express one irreducible relation; they may not conceal duplicated policy. Migrate every caller and delete displaced branches, defaults, wrappers, and compatibility readers in the same commit. Tests consume production contracts where practical. No magnitude thresholds, shape assumptions, distribution assumptions, family fallbacks, parallel registries, deferred adoption, or manually maintained counts. Each gated file records command-derived before/after pressure, code delta, authority, verifier, and closure retirement. Publish the complete queue and closure state as RepoDB evidence after each wave. Plan complete means every census file row is closed, every derivation-blocked row is resolved, no stale binding remains, and a fresh census finds no uncatalogued production decision or copied test policy. Merge current master after every gated step.

items.title: Eliminate model, projector, inference, and modality facts duplicated in code

steps.title: Move model facts to artifacts and recipes and make compiled neutral plans their sole consumers
steps.rationale: Model dimensions, token IDs, topology choices, and modality geometry must not remain as family or checkpoint literals in generic runtime code.

items.title: Classify and consolidate format, quantization, codec, and artifact constants

steps.title: Bind specification values to typed protocol owners and eliminate duplicated encodings and layout arithmetic
steps.rationale: Specification constants may remain, but only in their protocol owner and never duplicated as runtime policy.

items.title: Close remaining production and command magic surfaces

steps.title: Audit every remaining internal and cmd owner and delete redundant flags, defaults, wrappers, and process constants
steps.rationale: Scoped waves must not leave uncatalogued debt in converters, tools, automation, or less frequently exercised packages.

items.title: Remove duplicated production policy from tests

steps.title: Use production contracts and shared assertions while retaining irreducible typed fixtures
steps.rationale: Tests should exercise production behavior rather than reimplement defaults, exit codes, dimensions, or tolerance policy in assertions.

items.title: Reach and enforce zero open magic debt

steps.title: Close every derivation-blocked row and verify no stale, uncatalogued, or duplicated authority remains
steps.rationale: The campaign ends only when unresolved constants have been derived, replaced, consolidated, or made irrelevant.

steps.title: Make the zero-debt checks permanent and delete campaign-only import and compatibility machinery
steps.rationale: The result must remain enforced without retaining one-time migration surface.
